minor.issue: Still swallows all exceptions silently via try/except broad — if project schema drifts the log warning is the only signal. Consider re-raising in dev/test mode.
send_telegram still sync-inline (timeout=15s) — same concern flagged in Iter6. Not blocking Iter7.

When order-level artist_statuses changes from Freelance→Tim for an artist, the existing linked freelance_project is NOT deleted/marked inactive. Orphan projects will linger if user flips status back. Consider reconciliation.

Uses bare .format with unknown-placeholder safety net, but if template contains a positional {} it will still raise IndexError which is caught and falls back — verified working but not explicitly tested.

issues: Textareas use whitespace-pre font-mono which is fine, but height is fixed (6 lines) → for the 'custom' template (multi-line) user may need to scroll inside textarea. Minor UX — not blocking.

action_items: Consider reconciliation when PUT /api/orders removes an artist's 'Freelance' flag — the existing linked freelance_projects record should be deleted or archived (currently orphaned with stale order_ref_id).
Optional: apply existing Iter6 backlog items (BackgroundTasks for telegram, per-order exchange-rate snapshot).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py render_tg_template line 113-120: fallback is safe but the try/except catches ALL Exception — a typo in the *default* template (e.g. positional {}) would also be silently swallowed into empty default. Scope except to (KeyError, IndexError) for better signal.

server.py _sync_freelance_artists line 358: find uses {order_ref_id, artist_id}. If an admin later deletes the freelance_artist, the linked project still has stale artist_id pointing nowhere. Consider cascade cleanup or nullable artist_id with soft-ref.

server.py _sync_freelance_artists line 333: fee split equally across freelancers is fair, but if `order.fee_freelance` is 0 then projects are created with fee=0 — they still count toward freelance dashboard. Acceptable but worth documenting.

Settings.jsx Template editor: no client-side validation that placeholder names match the known vars ({project, klien, folder_code, deadline, days_left}). Users can save broken templates; backend fallback handles this, but a UI warning would be nicer UX.
OrderModal.jsx line 214: grid-template-columns hardcoded inline style — consider extracting to Tailwind arbitrary-value class for consistency with rest of codebase.
